nina: Following up on the postmortemwe lost a chunk of spans due to ETL watermark units being interpreted as seconds vs ms. Need owners for backfill and alerts.

raj: Can take the backfill. Will snapshot aggregates first and run a dry replay. JIRA OBS-5120.

sam: I'll add an alert: 'span_backfill_needed' when span_ingest_rate drops >25% for 10m. Also add a synthetic emitter to validate path.

devops-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance requested for backfill window.

nina: Action items: raj: backfill + dry run (OBS-5120) - dry run Thu, prod Fri. sam: dashboards + alert + synthetic - Wed AM. nina: update postmortem and owners, schedule follow-up.

raj: PRs and backfill plan linked in the JIRA.

sam: Will add unit test to config parser to normalize units.

nina: Sync next Mon 10:00 UTC. If anyone misses ETA, call it out here. :thumbsup:
